children: Overview
Denmark wall materials maker's Q3 revenue in local currencies fell 3% as sales volumes dropped 9%
Q3 adjusted EBIT margin rose to 8% from 7% last year
Company narrowed 2026 revenue and EBIT guidance amid ongoing market challenges
Outlook
Company expects 2026 revenue growth in local currencies between -4% and -1%
H+H sees 2026 EBIT before special items at DKK 65-85 mln
Company says inflation remains a key challenge for its outlook
Result Drivers
COST PASS-THROUGH - Co said passing on higher costs to customers helped protect margins despite lower volumes
PRODUCTION INITIATIVES - Improved performance from HOME programme and German restructuring supported results
